parsed.scene_description: A blurred indoor scene of a modern lounge or cafe with tiered seating and ambient lighting. In the foreground, dark retractable belt barriers are visible on the left. The mid-ground contains orange armchairs arranged around tables where people are seated. A large screen displays a person in the center background. To the right, a tall shelving unit holds books or decorative items under spiral light fixtures. Bright light sources create glare on the left side.

objects.label: retractable belt barrier
objects.observation: Dark horizontal bands supported by vertical posts located in the lower-left foreground. They appear to be made of plastic or metal and are positioned to separate areas.

objects.label: orange armchair
objects.observation: Multiple orange upholstered chairs with curved backs. One is clearly visible in the center-right foreground, another partially behind it. They have metal bases with wheels.

objects.label: large display screen
objects.observation: A rectangular screen mounted on a wall in the background center. It shows a person's face and is illuminated with purple ambient light around its frame.

objects.label: spiral light fixture
objects.observation: A tall, vertical assembly of concentric circular LED rings located on the right side. The rings are stacked and emit bright white light.

objects.label: bookshelf unit
objects.observation: A tall vertical structure on the right side filled with numerous small rectangular items resembling books or decorative blocks. It is illuminated from within.
